how_to_apply: Go to "Online Application" → click Apply → select GSSSB.
Select Advertisement No. 455/2026-27, Sanitary Inspector, Class-3 and click Apply.
Read the "More Details" notification carefully before proceeding.
Click "Apply Now" → "Skip" to open the application format and fill in Personal Details.
Fill in Educational Details in the next step.
Accept the declaration/assurance ("Yes") and click Save to generate the Application Number.
Upload photograph and signature in the prescribed JPG format and size.
Click "Confirm Application" after a final review.
Download and keep a printout of the confirmed application.
Pay the requisite examination fee online by 03 September 2026, 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Sanitary Inspector Important Dates
content_sections.text: Note: Educational qualification, age limit, and category-certificate validity are all reckoned as of the last date of application, 31 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Sanitary Inspector Vacancy 2026 (Category-wise)
content_sections.text: 10 Unreserved (General) 12 Reserved Category Total 22 Total Posts Note: The notification states the number of posts may increase or decrease. Reserved-category vacancies are applicable only to candidates who are original residents of Gujarat and belong to the respective reserved category.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Sanitary Inspector Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India, or possess nationality as provided under Rule-7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Important: Candidates lacking a valid computer-knowledge certificate may still apply, but must submit proof of passing a basic computer knowledge test before appointment; failure to do so will lead to cancellation of selection.

rows.details: Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSC) or equivalent recognized by the Government
Minimum one-year Health Sanitary Inspector's Diploma course from a Government-recognized institute
OR minimum one-year Health Sanitary Inspector's certificate course from an ITI or Government-recognized educational institute
Basic computer application knowledge as prescribed under Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967
Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi, or both

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Sanitary Inspector Pay Scale 2026
content_sections.text: Regularization after 5 years remains subject to the outcome of SLP No. 14124/2012 and SLP No. 14125/2012 pending before the Supreme Court, as stated in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Sanitary Inspector Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a single-stage competitive written examination (CBRT/OMR based), conducted in two parts: Total 210 questions (multiple-choice), 210 marks, combined duration of 3 hours (180 minutes) for Part A and Part B. Negative marking: ¼ mark deducted for each wrong answer. Qualifying standard: Minimum 40% separately in both Part A and Part B, for all categories. Document verification is called for candidates up to approximately twice the number of vacancies per category, based on provisional merit. Final selection list and waiting list are prepared based on marks obtained, category-wise vacancies, and document verification outcome.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSSSB Sanitary Inspector Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Only the last confirmed application (with fee paid) will be considered valid if a candidate submits more than one application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSC) / equivalent qualification certificate Health Sanitary Inspector's Diploma / ITI certificate Computer knowledge certificate/diploma, if available Birth date proof Category certificate, as applicable Disability certificate, where applicable Ex-servicemen documents, where applicable Widow status supporting documents, where applicable Recognised sports certificate, where applicable Recent passport-size photograph and signature

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved posts will not get reserved-category relaxations. Category details cannot be changed after confirmation. Eligible widow women candidates may receive additional merit marks subject to conditions. Eligible sports candidates may receive additional merit marks. Scribe/compensatory time facility is available to eligible candidates as per rules. Applicable Gujarat recruitment and examination rules govern the recruitment. Malpractice may result in disqualification and legal action. Passing the written examination does not itself confer a right to appointment. The Board reserves the right to modify or cancel the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. How many Sanitary Inspector posts are available?
faq.answer: GSSSB has notified 22 posts of Sanitary Inspector, Class-3, under Advt. No. 455/2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 31 August 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 33 years as on 31 August 2026, subject to applicable relaxation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: HSC along with the required Health Sanitary Inspector Diploma/ITI certificate and other prescribed requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: Fixed pay of ₹26,000 per month for the first 5 years, followed by the applicable regular Level-4 scale after satisfactory service.

faq.question: Q6. What is the exam pattern?
faq.answer: A CBRT/OMR objective examination carrying 210 marks with Part A and Part B.
